cohort: Patients diagnosed with patent ductus arteriosus (PDA) and/or bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) identified through ICD-10 codes from the National Inpatient Sample (NIS) between 2016 and 2020.
finding: The study confirmed a significant association between patent ductus arteriosus (PDA) and bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) (adjusted odds ratio 2.43), with BPD patients with PDA exhibiting higher mortality rates, extremely preterm birth prevalence, and extremely low birth weight prevalence.
